policy: feature(t) may use only events with timestamp < t (strict-before causality)

A_future_insertion.description: future row (ts=2016-01-01) ingested before row at 2015-01-02; row A's features must be unchanged because its ts is before the future row

B_backdated_insertion.description: backdated row (ts=2014-12-31) IS included in history of 2015-01-02 (ts < t is the correct criterion)

C_shuffled_ingestion.description: identical timestamps → sorted state is deterministic regardless of ingestion order

remediation_required: UserVelocityTracker and EntityFraudRateTracker must accept optional ts parameter; sorted-state behavior for feature computation; incremental counters for large-scale replay
